Scope: Metadata-only proposal; no file copies, uploads, deletions, history rewrites, credential-value reads, or content-based conflict resolutions performed.
Limitations: KeepCandidate does not independently prove an image is the currently approved final asset.
Content scans and file hashes must be checked before uploading; matching a historical blob does not prove an uncommitted file is unchanged.
Other computer changes and LFS data have not been compared.
Source checkout can change concurrently. Re-run collection/classification immediately before packaging.
